ad_intro:
Why a performance-marketing audit includes the website: Meta does not make you money. The click does. CPL is paid on the ad; conversion happens on the landing, the form, WhatsApp speed-to-lead, and proof. If the ad is 'solar for home' and the page is 'Powering the World Responsibly' with broken counters and no UGC, you rented the click and lost the kit. That is the whole job of this audit - ads, site, form, creative, tracking as one funnel. Teaching cut: fix the page or the Rs.20 L+/mo is a brand video, not performance.

SWELECT Energy Systems Ltd (NSE/BSE SWELECTES, formerly Numeric Power, 1984). SWELECT House, 5 Sir P.S. Sivasamy Salai, Mylapore, Chennai 600004. CEO-MD Dr. Arulkumar Shanmugasundaram. FY26 consol. Rs.657 Cr revenue (+5.7%), PAT Rs.57.6 Cr, EBITDA ~Rs.187 Cr (PV-Magazine India / ScanX, May-Jul 2026). 1 GW+ SHPV Coimbatore (ALMM, BIS, IEC/UL; Nexora TOPCon to 23.32%, Celestia, TeSirius Mono PERC). Salem MMS 750 MW+. Claims 10,700+ installs, 1 GW+ project experience, 41+ years. IPP goal 1 GW. Day-1 file 14 Sep 2026: 7/10 HOT, ~25 ads, Website dest, Rs.20 L+/mo est., pitch_fit HIGH.

Live check 14 Sep 2026: swelect.com returns HTTP 500. Brand is swelectes.com. Hero = 'Powering the World Responsibly'. Stat widgets render 16 / 2 / 9 / 1 (years / Experience / PV GW / MMS) - JS not firing. Nav typo knwoledge-hub. Products are factory stills (Nexora/Celestia/TeSirius). Full CFA table lives on /solutions/residential.php (Rs.30k/kW, Rs.18k, cap Rs.78,000) - not the homepage, not the ad. CTA = enquiry form (Dealership/Queries/Complaints + Lead Source incl. Intersolar Feb 2025) or tel 9176001012 / 1800 425 9600. Residential channel: Deepa, 9543644255, channels@swelectes.com. IG live @swelect_energy_systems (746 / 480, 'Now launching NUMERGY') - Day-1 @swelectenergy is stale. No sitewide WhatsApp.

Day-1 leak, confirmed: zero customer UGC / unboxing / roof Reels - studio + factory journey blog. Plus: corporate hero vs buried CFA, dead swelect.com, 0-ish counters, SPGS with no price, Website not WhatsApp. All fixable in 14 days. Ad counts are Day-1 estimates. Never promise subsidy approval.
ad_intelligence: Ad Library is 30% of the leak. The other 70% is: (1) does the landing match the hook, (2) can they WhatsApp in <5 min, (3) is there proof a neighbour installed, (4) does the form ask too much, (5) is tracking on kit/enquire not just PageView. SWELECT fails 1-4 on the live site. That is why we audit swelectes.com, not only the 25 creatives.

findings: Why we audit the website (performance, not branding): You pay Meta for a click. If that URL is a 41-year corporate story with counters at 16/2/9/1, the rupee left the building. Performance marketing = hook in the ad, same hook above the fold, one CTA, proof, speed-to-lead, event firing on enquire/WhatsApp. SWELECT's listed-company site is built for investors and EPC RFPs. NUMERGY is a D2C kit. Those are two landings. Mixing them is why Website-destination ads look expensive.

UGC leak (Day-1, confirmed 14 Sep 2026): PV module page is packshot Nexora/Celestia/TeSirius. Knowledge hub is 'Journey of a Solar Panel: From Factory to Installation'. SPGS is a kit still. IG 746 followers launching NUMERGY with no roof unboxing volume. 10,700+ installs and a Coimbatore 1 GW line are the UGC engine - they are not the ad. Waaree/Tata/Loom win residential auctions with terrace Reels. Shoot 15 NUMERGY roofs in Chennai/CBE (before/after, net-meter, Tamil/Hinglish).

CFA is one click down, not the ad: /solutions/residential.php has the full PM Surya Ghar table (Rs.30,000/kW, Rs.18,000, cap Rs.78,000, GHS/RWA) and a non-subsidy + home-loan path - good, and it hedges MNRE. Homepage is 'Powering the World Responsibly'. SPGS names the scheme with no rupee. Rooftop 'Read more' on home goes to EPC contracts (LCOE, utility farms). Put NUMERGY + 'eligible for up to Rs.78,000 via an MNRE path; SWELECT does not approve subsidy' on the first screen of the residential ad URL. TN state top-up exists in 2026 conversations - only if you can document it; never promise.

No WhatsApp, long form, dead domain: Day-1 dest = Website. 1800 425 9600 + 9176001012 + enquiry (Dealership/Queries/Complaints). Deepa 9543644255 is buried on residential.php. 9pm '3 kW NUMERGY kitna?' will not call Mylapore. Ad CTA = WhatsApp 9543644255 or 9176001012. Form = city + phone + kW. 301 swelect.com (HTTP 500) to swelectes.com. Kill Feb 2025 expo in Lead Source.

Broken counters + no kit price: Hero stats 16 / 2 Experience / 9 / 1 - same JS leak as Fenice/Freyr/Okaya. About page has 41+ years, 1 GW+, 10,700 installs - hard-code those. SPGS 1-10 kW 'ready to install' with zero MRP. A listed manufacturer can publish a from-Rs. band (modules + kit) without being Amazon. knwoledge-hub typo. SPGS homepage card has no link.

Two businesses, one URL: Module/ALMM/C&I/IPP (Rs.657 Cr) vs NUMERGY home kits. One Website campaign buys both. Split: (a) residential NUMERGY + CFA + UGC + WhatsApp, (b) C&I EPC/BESS, (c) module/channel. Investor ODR/Saksham Niveshak blocks on the consumer path are noise. Justdial 3.5 is the Maps problem 10,700 installs should have killed.
competitors: Residential nav, CFA in the first screen, dealer + D2C, UGC roofs. Tata is the DISCOM-trust default after a 1-star.
You have ALMM + 1 GW Coimbatore + NUMERGY. Lead with that kit, not 'responsible power'. DCR/ALMM is the Tata objection.
Freyr hero is Save Rs.1 Lakh. SolarSquare city pages + 15k Google ratings. Fenice at least has customer videos on /about-us/.
You bury CFA on residential.php. They put rupees on the ad. WhatsApp vs your 1800.
Unboxing Reels, 3-field WhatsApp, 48-hour survey. They cannot match 1 GW ALMM; they win the 9pm click.
NUMERGY UGC + WhatsApp Deepa's number. Factory footage is B2B.
The CFA table already exists. The ad does not send anyone there. Homepage sends rooftop clicks to EPC contracts.
Residential ad URL = /solutions/residential.php or a /numergy/ kit LP. Not the corporate home.
